title: MargNet
summary: MargNet is a differentially-private tabular data synthesis method that constructs neural-network models over adaptively selected marginals, compared against several DP baselines. One baseline, method/CTGAN, vendors and modifies the CTGAN synthesizer's source into a differentially-private RDP variant (DPCTGANSynthesizerRDP) used as a comparison method; the SDV family's rdt is also imported (commented out) but never actually run.
evidence: method/CTGAN/scripts/dp_ctgan_rdp.py:12-16 imports CTGANSynthesizer, DataSampler, DataTransformer from vendored ctgan/ and adds RDP accountant for DP training
needs: rdt import in method/GEM/Util/gan/ctgan/transformer.py is commented out and appears unused; unclear if rdt ever ran in this repo.
